body: An open-source embedded retrieval library for multimodal AI.
plain_description: **Store and search multimodal data for AI applications in one place.** Build vector, full-text, and SQL search over text, images, videos, and other data. Start with the open-source embedded product or use the enterprise offering for distributed search.
technical_description: LanceDB is an open-source embedded retrieval library and multimodal data platform built on the Lance columnar format. It supports storing, indexing, and searching vectors and multimodal data, including vector similarity search, full-text search, and SQL. It provides Python, TypeScript, and Rust SDKs, plus a REST API. The README also describes a separate enterprise product for distributed search, indexing, and maintenance.
title: LanceDB
